name: image-weathered-portrait
title: Weathered Portrait
description: Close-up character study with an aqua-toned texture overlay

subject.descent: Not asserted — synthetic subject; specify explicitly when recreating.
subject.physical: Deeply lined face, heavy brow, full grey-white beard, close-cropped hair; head square to camera

composition.depthOfField: Shallow; edges of the frame dissolve

framing.subjectScale: Head fills essentially the entire frame — face spans ~100% of frame width
framing.subjectBox: Head x≈0–100%, y≈0–92%; glasses span x≈8–92% at y≈36–46%
framing.anchors: Eyeline at ~40% from top; nose tip ~57%; mouth ~72%; beard base ~90%
framing.edges: Scalp cropped flat by the top edge; both ears cropped by the side edges; collar exits the bottom edge
framing.negativeSpace: Zero headroom and zero side margin — the crop is deliberately claustrophobic

environment.background: Dark aqua field broken by liquid and droplet texture overlaying the skin
environment.depth: Subject only, with texture treated as an overlay rather than a scene

lighting.direction: Strong side key from camera-left, minimal fill
lighting.temperature: Cool — heavy teal and aqua cast throughout
lighting.shadows: High contrast; deep shadow on the off side, specular highlights on droplets

camera.quality: Hyper-detailed skin texture, heavy micro-contrast, sharpened grade
camera.artifacts: Chromatic fringing in the droplet texture

atmosphere.story: A face that has been through weather and is still looking straight at you.
atmosphere.micro: Slight asymmetry in the brow; unbroken eye contact
